The story follows a strong-willed Missouri farm girl who joins her family’s overland migration to the Oregon Country, mixing frontier hardships with questions of conscience. As Kate proves her mettle on the trail, she balances affection for steadfast Ben Hardy and a complicated attraction to Isaac Pelton, a gentleman slaveholder whose convictions collide with hers. At the Missouri River they enter a vast encampment of emigrants—Methodists, Mormons, and handcart parties—where a ferry accident nearly drowns Kate before Ben and helpful Native rescuers save her; Quakers comfort the shaken family, and a new teamster, Douglas Craig, replaces a troublesome hand.
